covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Newcastle Central, Sunderland and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

notCovered.label: Tyne and Wear Metro
notCovered.detail: Not covered — no confirmed public live-times feed exists for Metro, so Metro stops aren't offered in the station picker or Near me for now, and no Metro board is offered rather than showing a stale timetable dressed up as live. They stay on file for when a confirmed feed exists.

stations: 88 stations and stops: 28 National Rail stations across Tyne and Wear and the North East (14 Sep 2026 UK station fill, phase 2a) plus 60 Tyne and Wear Metro stops.
notes: At Sunderland, Metro and National Rail trains share the same platforms — shown together, not yet split into separate boards.
